question: National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS) is located at ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Institute of Mountaineering and Adventure Sports (NIMAS)** is located in **Dirang, Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• NIMAS is a premier institute in India providing training in mountaineering, aero, and aqua adventure sports.
 
• It was established to develop and promote adventure sports and mountaineering in the country.
 
• The institute offers various courses and expeditions to promote adventure tourism and skill development in these fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is known for its diverse topography and is a popular destination for adventure sports and mountaineering activities.
 
• The state is home to several high-altitude peaks, dense forests, and rivers that provide ample opportunities for various adventure sports.
 
• NIMAS collaborates with various national and international organizations to conduct training programs and expeditions.
 
• The institute also plays a significant role in promoting eco-tourism and sustainable adventure tourism practices in the region.
